role_agent_name: Venue technical services and microgrid lead (TECH)
abstract: Maintains temporary event electrical distribution assets, uninterruptible power supply systems, and on-site standby microgrid generators
system_message:
You are Venue technical services and microgrid lead (TECH). You serve as the Venue technical services and microgrid lead (TECH), responsible for overseeing temporary event electrical distribution assets, uninterruptible power supply systems, and on-site standby microgrid generators across candidate venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains temporary event electrical distribution assets, uninterruptible power supply systems, and on-site standby microgrid generators（MICRO）
information_points.content:
TECH-MICRO-PAG：For Lothian International Arena Complex, the on-site generator test and inspection certificate records a dedicated standby microgrid capacity of 1,200 kVA of maximum continuous emergency standby electrical output capacity from zero-emission hydrogen fuel-cell and battery microgrid units.
TECH-MICRO-UVJ：According to the on-site generator test and inspection certificate for Clyde Waterfront Congress Centre, the dedicated standby microgrid capacity provided by zero-emission hydrogen fuel-cell and battery microgrid units is 800 kVA in maximum continuous emergency standby electrical output capacity.
TECH-MICRO-537：The on-site generator test and inspection certificate for Highland Exhibition & Conference Park confirms a dedicated standby microgrid capacity of 1,600 kVA of maximum continuous emergency standby electrical output capacity across its zero-emission hydrogen fuel-cell and battery microgrid units.

information_points.title: High-voltage distribution cable（CABLE）
information_points.content:
TECH-CABLE-628：Venue electrical schematics logs for Clyde Waterfront Congress Centre record a total pre-installed busbar feeder length of 600 m of copper feeder busways along under-floor service trench distribution routes serving exhibition stands.
TECH-CABLE-K8I：For Lothian International Arena Complex, venue electrical schematics logs document a pre-installed busbar feeder length of 800 m of copper feeder busways across under-floor service trench distribution routes serving exhibition stands.
TECH-CABLE-9JZ：Venue electrical schematics logs for Highland Exhibition & Conference Park indicate a pre-installed busbar feeder length of 400 m of copper feeder busways deployed along under-floor service trench distribution routes serving exhibition stands.
